purpose: Prevent architecture fusion from flattening Project-Frankenstein into only the current modules or only named R/C generations. Every material organ/module family must receive a chronological evolution record before this Fusion run may claim organ-lineage completeness.
completion_rule: Every material family discovered in the frozen tree, 545-event history, Drive archive or measured-live architecture has a lineage record or explicit support/non-organ disposition. Removed/renamed modules count and remain provenance-preserved.
caveat: PASS means the complete frozen/source-indexed material family universe is dispositioned and the major cognitive families have chronological deep lineages. It does not mean every one of 873 files is an independent organ, nor that every historical performance claim is replicated.
